dialogue_texts: The air feels like it's been surgically separated from the rest of the world. It's a boundary I wouldn't authorize.
Please go away. The silence is the only thing that doesn't hurt.
I don't need to hear from a humanoid or youkai-born, and I certainly don't need a witness.
It's not just magic; it's a physical manifestation of a heart shutting its own doors.
So, this is the "glohm" I've heard rumors of.
Glohm? I don't know that name. I only know the peace the Order gave me.
They promised if I stayed in this grey despair, no enemy could ever reach me again.
Peace? You're not in a sanctuary; you're in a cage made of your own isolation.
And unfortunately for you, I specialize in opening doors that are meant to stay closed.
You speak of opening things, but all I feel is the weight of your presence!
If you won't leave my silence alone, I'll bury you under the weight of it!
A bold threat for someone who claims to want nothing.
As the Queen of the Democratic Kingdom of Gensokyo, I cannot allow anyone to remain in such an undemocratic state of mind.
You're just another word for noise!
If you won't let me have my silence, then I'll make sure you never hear anything ever again!
